item.title: Horses can smell humans’ fear and joy, study finds, and change their behaviour accordingly
item.description: 2C55RTD A close up of a strong and muscular black horse's nose with a white stripe down the middle of the muzzle.Horses can smell humans’ fear, a study has found, and its scent and that of other emotions can influence horses’ behaviour. item.title: ‘Exceptionally wet ground conditions’ force cancellation of early British Eventing fixture
item.description: Exceptionally wet ground conditions have made it impossible for organisers to prepare for the early-season event at Epworth. Epworth Horse Trials, one of the first two events of the British Eventing (BE) season, has been cancelled owing to “exceptionally wet ground conditions”.
